service: sivakassi-pyropark-shop-v2

custom:
  stage: dev
  region: ap-south-1

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: nodejs24.x
  versionFunctions: false
  stage: ${self:custom.stage}
  timeout: 60

  environment:
    JWT_SECRET: ${env:JWT_SECRET}
    CART_TABLE: Carts-${self:custom.stage}
    PRODUCTS_TABLE: Products-${self:custom.stage}
    ORDERS_TABLE: Orders-${self:custom.stage}
    BULK_ORDERS_TABLE: BulkOrders-${self:custom.stage}
    BRAND_TABLE: Brands-${self:custom.stage}
    CATEGORY_TABLE: Categories-${self:custom.stage}
    USERS_TABLE: Users-${self:custom.stage}
    ADMIN_CONFIG_TABLE: AdminConfig-${self:custom.stage}
    DISCOUNT_TABLE: Discounts-${self:custom.stage}
    CONTACT_TABLE: ContactUs-${self:custom.stage}
    COUPONS_TABLE: Coupons-${self:custom.stage}
    OTP_TABLE: OtpTable-${self:custom.stage}
    ADMIN_CODES_TABLE: AdminCodes-${self:custom.stage}
    FLASH_SALES_TABLE: FlashSales-${self:custom.stage}
    OTP_TEMPLATE_ID: ${env:OTP_TEMPLATE_ID}
    CONFIRM_ORDER_TID: ${env:CONFIRM_ORDER_TID}
    ORDER_SUBMIT_TID: ${env:ORDER_SUBMIT_TID}
    PAYMENT_CONFIRM_TID: ${env:PAYMENT_CONFIRM_TID}
    CART_UPDATED_TID: ${env:CART_UPDATED_TID}
    ORDER_DISPATCHED_TID: ${env:ORDER_DISPATCHED_TID}
    MSG91_ESTIMATE_TEMPLATE: ${env:MSG91_ESTIMATE_TEMPLATE}
    MSG91_EMAIL_FROM: ${env:MSG91_EMAIL_FROM}
    MSG91_EMAIL_DOMAIN: ${env:MSG91_EMAIL_DOMAIN}
    MSG91_EMAIL_FROM_NAME: ${env:MSG91_EMAIL_FROM_NAME}
    DOMAIN: ${env:DOMAIN}
    MSG91_AUTH_KEY: ${env:MSG91_AUTH_KEY}
    RECAPTCHA_SECRET: ${env:RECAPTCHA_SECRET}
    MAX_AI_PRODUCT_QTY: 10
    BUCKET_NAME: sivakasi-pyropark-${aws:accountId}-${self:provider.stage}
    CLOUDFRONT_DOMAIN: ${env:CLOUDFRONT_DOMAIN}
    DISTRIBUTION_ID: ${env:DISTRIBUTION_ID}
    STAGE: ${self:custom.stage}

  httpApi:
    cors:
      allowedOrigins:
        - http://localhost:5173
        - https://frontend-cracker-shop.vercel.app
        - https://d1wqhtxjg6zqoo.cloudfront.net
        - https://sivakasipyropark.co.in
        - https://www.sivakasipyropark.co.in
        - https://dz9f4nfbnyjk1.cloudfront.net
        - https://www.sivakasicrackers.co.in
        - https://sivakasicrackers.co.in

      allowedHeaders:
        - Content-Type
        - Authorization
        - x-guest-id

      allowedMethods:
        - GET
        - POST
        - PUT
        - DELETE
        - PATCH

      allowCredentials: false

    binaryMediaTypes:
      - application/pdf

  iam:
    role:
      statements:
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - dynamodb:GetItem
            - dynamodb:PutItem
            - dynamodb:UpdateItem
            - dynamodb:Query
            - dynamodb:Scan
            - dynamodb:DeleteItem
            - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
            - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
          Resource:
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${self:custom.region}:*:table/Users-${self:custom.stage}
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${self:custom.region}:*:table/Users-${self:custom.stage}/index/*
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${self:custom.region}:*:table/Products-${self:custom.stage}
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${self:custom.region}:*:table/Products-${self:custom.stage}/index/*
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${self:custom.region}:*:table/Categories-${self:custom.stage}
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${self:custom.region}:*:table/Brands-${self:custom.stage}
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${self:custom.region}:*:table/Discounts-${self:custom.stage}
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${self:custom.region}:*:table/Carts-${self:custom.stage}
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${self:custom.region}:*:table/Orders-${self:custom.stage}
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${self:custom.region}:*:table/Orders-${self:custom.stage}/index/*
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${self:custom.region}:*:table/BulkOrders-${self:custom.stage}
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${self:custom.region}:*:table/BulkOrders-${self:custom.stage}/index/*
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${self:custom.region}:*:table/AdminConfig-${self:custom.stage}
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${self:custom.region}:*:table/ContactUs-${self:custom.stage}
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${self:custom.region}:*:table/OtpTable-${self:custom.stage}
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${self:custom.region}:*:table/Coupons-${self:custom.stage}
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${self:custom.region}:*:table/AdminCodes-${self:custom.stage}
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${self:custom.region}:*:table/FlashSales-${self:custom.stage}
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${self:custom.region}:*:table/FlashSales-${self:custom.stage}/index/*

        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - s3:ListBucket
          Resource:
            - arn:aws:s3:::sivakasi-pyropark-${aws:accountId}-${self:provider.stage}

        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - s3:PutObject
            - s3:GetObject
            - s3:DeleteObject
          Resource:
            - arn:aws:s3:::sivakasi-pyropark-${aws:accountId}-${self:provider.stage}/products/*
            - arn:aws:s3:::sivakasi-pyropark-${aws:accountId}-${self:provider.stage}/imports/*
            - arn:aws:s3:::sivakasi-pyropark-${aws:accountId}-${self:provider.stage}/brands/*
            - arn:aws:s3:::sivakasi-pyropark-${aws:accountId}-${self:provider.stage}/categories/*
            - arn:aws:s3:::sivakasi-pyropark-${aws:accountId}-${self:provider.stage}/config/*
            - arn:aws:s3:::sivakasi-pyropark-${aws:accountId}-${self:provider.stage}/templates/*
            - arn:aws:s3:::sivakasi-pyropark-${aws:accountId}-${self:provider.stage}/invoices/*
            - arn:aws:s3:::sivakasi-pyropark-${aws:accountId}-${self:provider.stage}/flash-sales/*

functions:
  bulkAdjustOrder:
    handler: src/handlers/bulkOrderAdjust.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /bulk-order/{orderId}/adjust
          method: PUT

      - httpApi:
          path: /bulk-order/{orderId}/discount
          method: PUT

  applyOrderDiscount:
    handler: src/handlers/orderDiscount.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /admin/orders/{orderId}/discount
          method: PUT

  adminRestoreProductsDiscounts:
    handler: src/handlers/adminRestoreProductDiscount.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /admin/discounts/products/restore
          method: POST

  adminInvoicePresign:
    handler: src/handlers/adminInvoicePresign.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /admin/orders/{orderId}/invoice/presign
          method: POST

  orderInvoice:
    handler: src/handlers/orderInvoice.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /orders/{orderId}/invoice
          method: GET

  adminRefreshOrderAmount:
    handler: src/handlers/adminRefreshOrderAmount.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /admin/orders/{orderId}/refresh-amount
          method: POST

  adminCreateComboPackage:
    handler: src/handlers/adminCreateComboPackage.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /admin/combo-packages
          method: POST

  adminGetComboPackages:
    handler: src/handlers/adminGetComboPackages.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /admin/combo-packages
          method: GET

  adminGetComboPackage:
    handler: src/handlers/adminGetComboPackage.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /admin/combo-packages/{comboId}
          method: GET

  adminUpdateComboPackage:
    handler: src/handlers/adminUpdateComboPackage.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /admin/combo-packages/{comboId}
          method: PUT

  adminAccountCreditReport:
    handler: src/handlers/adminAccountCreditReport.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /admin/reports/account-credits
          method: GET

  adminBulkAccountCreditReport:
    handler: src/handlers/adminBulkAccountCreditReport.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /admin/reports/bulk-account-credits
          method: GET

  adminBulkSalesReport:
    handler: src/handlers/adminBulkSalesReport.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /admin/reports/bulk-sales
          method: GET

  adminBulkUpdateAddress:
    handler: src/handlers/adminUpdateBulkOrderAddress.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /admin/bulk-orders/{orderId}/address
          method: PUT

  adminUpdateOrderAddress:
    handler: src/handlers/adminUpdateOrderAddress.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /admin/orders/{orderId}/address
          method: PUT

  adminDeleteComboPackage:
    handler: src/handlers/adminDeleteComboPackage.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /admin/combo-packages/{comboId}
          method: DELETE

  getUserByMobile:
    handler: src/handlers/getUserByMobile.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /admin/users/{mobile}
          method: GET

  adminApplyChitBalance:
    handler: src/handlers/adminApplyChitBalance.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /admin/orders/{orderId}/apply-chit-balance
          method: POST

  adminRevertChitBalance:
    handler: src/handlers/adminRevertChitBalance.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /admin/orders/{orderId}/revert-chit-balance
          method: POST

  createFlashSale:
    handler: src/handlers/flashSale.createHandler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /admin/flash-sales
          method: post

  listFlashSales:
    handler: src/handlers/flashSale.listHandler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /admin/flash-sales
          method: get

  getFlashSale:
    handler: src/handlers/flashSale.getHandler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /admin/flash-sales/{flashSaleId}
          method: get

  updateFlashSale:
    handler: src/handlers/flashSale.updateHandler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /admin/flash-sales/{flashSaleId}
          method: put

  cancelFlashSale:
    handler: src/handlers/flashSale.cancelHandler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /admin/flash-sales/{flashSaleId}
          method: delete

  adminFlashSalePresign:
    handler: src/handlers/flashSalePresign.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /admin/flash-sales/presign
          method: POST

  flashSaleScheduler:
    handler: src/handlers/flashSaleScheduler.handler
    events:
      - schedule:
          rate: cron(0 0 * * ? *)
          enabled: true

  getActiveFlashSales:
    handler: src/handlers/getActiveFlashSales.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /flash-sales/active
          method: get

  adminGetComboProductNames:
    handler: src/handlers/adminGetComboProductNames.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /admin/combo-packages/{comboProductId}/products
          method: get

resources:
  Resources:
    FlashSalesTable:
      Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
      Properties:
        TableName: FlashSales-${self:custom.stage}
        BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
        AttributeDefinitions:
          - AttributeName: flashSaleId
            AttributeType: S
          - AttributeName: productId
            AttributeType: S
          - AttributeName: startAt
            AttributeType: S
          - AttributeName: status
            AttributeType: S
          - AttributeName: endAt
            AttributeType: S

        KeySchema:
          - AttributeName: flashSaleId
            KeyType: HASH

        GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
          - IndexName: productId-startAt-index
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: productId
                KeyType: HASH
              - AttributeName: startAt
                KeyType: RANGE
            Projection:
              ProjectionType: ALL

          - IndexName: status-endAt-index
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: status
                KeyType: HASH
              - AttributeName: endAt
                KeyType: RANGE
            Projection:
              ProjectionType: ALL
